name: Hyper-Kamiokande
summary: Next-generation large water-Cherenkov experiment studying neutrino oscillations, astrophysical neutrinos and nucleon decay, with plans to improve indirect dark-matter searches.
detection_principle: A larger water target and sensitive photosensors record Cherenkov rings from neutrinos and associated charged particles.

status.label: Under construction
status.evidence: A 2026 paper confirms completion of the cavern. The current official description targets observations beginning in 2028; the older 2027 plan is no longer adopted directly.

timeline.event: Target start of observations; planned date

collaboration.name: Hyper-Kamiokande collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Only examples of lead or participating institutions directly established by the sources are listed. This is not a complete collaboration list, and listing does not imply equal institutional roles.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
